title: Release note, halved
instruction: Rewrite the note below in no more than 50 words. Output only the rewritten note, nothing else.
source: Release 2.9.4 of the ingest worker (tag ingest-w/2.9.4, commit 7f3c0a2e) fixed the retry storm reported in INC-1187 on 22 September, in which the SQS consumer re-queued every message whose receipt handle exceeded 1024 bytes. Priyanka Oyelaran-Whitcombe found that the handle length check used the pre-base64 size. The cap is now 2048 bytes and the check runs after encoding. The Fernhollow and Stavely tenants, who had 9300 messages delayed, were replayed from the dead-letter queue within four hours. The change is behind the flag INGEST_HANDLE_V2 until 2.10.
